name: PDF Knowledge Ingest Workflow
description: Turn an attached or remote PDF into durable Jarvis knowledge: securely normalize the source in Stash, extract clean text, create a detailed summary and keywords, write and ingest a structured Intel file, and publish a source-attributed Canvas briefing.

steps.description: Securely download a remote PDF into Stash when a URL was supplied
Extract readable text from every PDF page and archive the cleaned text in Stash

params.focus: Preserve concrete facts, definitions, procedures, specifications, limits, warnings, numeric values, research findings, catalog entries, conclusions, and useful page references. Omit repeated headers, footers, and boilerplate.

steps.description: Create a compact, detailed summary with factual coverage across the PDF
Extract retrieval keywords from the full PDF text
Create a structured Intel file from the factual PDF summary
Ingest the Intel file now so the processed fact count is known
Publish a concise Canvas briefing with complete source attribution

success_speech: PDF ingest complete. I extracted ${pdf_page_count} pages, archived the cleaned text, created ${intel_file}, processed ${ingest_fact_count} facts during ingestion, and published the Canvas briefing.
abort_speech: PDF ingest failed at a required step. Attach one readable PDF or provide a direct PDF URL, then retry.
